content.role: Additional common-harness quality evidence, not primary purpose

scope.primary: Common harness end-to-end quality; CI Workflow Agent is one additional scope.
scope.mutation: Only this private report; no commits, reruns, dispatch, status publication, merge, native configuration or other Work edits.
scope.dataSource: Maintained native GitHub connector GET operations plus preserved Root verification records and local immutable historical commits.
coverageLimitations: First page only; sample is bounded and selection is not a random population sample.
Attempt 1 jobs were fetched for each rerun/failure run; latest conclusions come from workflow-run readback. Successful single-attempt jobs were not exhaustively fetched.
Full status lists in the sample fit within per_page=100. No deleted historical statuses can be recovered.

Literal composite failure text alone does not distinguish absence, held status or wrong publisher; later successful status timestamps and exact-source bindings support publication ordering as the recurrence mechanism.
No live runtime configuration, private domain records or credentials were inspected.

clusters.title: Merge commit exact-head proof arrives after the first gate completes
clusters.classification: Repeated evidence publication and consumer readiness ordering
clusters.observed: 18 independent main push runs had successful source checks, failed exact-head review on attempt 1 and latest successful attempt 2. Every fetched exact-head success status was created after the first review job completed.
clusters.interpretation: A newly created merge commit requires its own explicit same-tree successor binding. Prior PR success does not publish that binding for the new head. The unchanged-source rerun after publication repairs each recorded incident but does not demonstrate that future publication ordering is solved.
clusters.currentness: All 18 recorded runs are now success; no currently failing source defect is asserted.

existingMitigation.source: ci/source-check.ts: protected-main-only bounded absence readiness wait (60 seconds), immediate refusal for present held/wrong publisher statuses, API errors or unproven absence.
existingMitigation.observedResidual: Common run39104989144 failed after the 60-second wait; success status was created at07:51:25Z, after review ended06:43:33Z. Thus the bounded wait does not cover delayed accountable publication.
existingMitigation.syntheticEvidenceWarning: ci/review-gate.test.ts log messages about late statuses are injected unit fixtures, not additional real incidents or live acceptance.

clusters.owner: Accountable Root/Lead and native proof publisher own exact reviewed source binding/publication; CI owns validating it; common harness owns source/evidence joins and readiness semantics.
clusters.qualityCriterion: Reconstruct head, tree, review result, immutable receipt, authenticated status, publisher, current findings and check attempt separately. Never treat tree equality, PR green or eventual retry green as proof already available to the first consumer.
clusters.scenario: Replay offline: identical reviewed tree with new merge head; exact-head status is late, absent, held, wrong publisher, stale tree or API failure. Candidate must produce a correct held/deferred readiness state and an authorized owner handoff without weakening the gate or issuing effects.
preventionLayers: Common typed evidence join and explicit readiness classification
Native publisher accountable sequencing with expected-head CAS and immutable successor binding
Offline CI fixture matrix covering late publication and negative publisher/tree/current-finding cases
Completion readback reports all attempts and cause-specific status, not only final green
clusters.acceptanceBoundary: No automatic merge, generic retry authority, status forgery or infinite wait follows.

clusters.title: New skill files were not included in the explicit bundle contract
clusters.classification: One independent source closure incident; two failing jobs are one incident
clusters.literalFailure: Skill member set differs from its explicit source allowlist.
clusters.observed: Both authored source and prospective merge runtime layout steps failed while the broad canonical source suite and quality checks passed. Commit46fb130c24ffd45ad9dbc7f2ef96b122cc80012b adds references/standing-typed-engineering-decision.json and references/native-learning.json to the two exact skill member declarations; commit4835678dc37c8f473edf20a3e6f29a52a7f98a36 updates the positive bundle fixture from9 to11 files.
clusters.causeConfidence: Direct diagnostic plus corrective source diff.
clusters.owner: Canonical skill/source-contract author and runtime-layout verifier owner; native projection/adoption remains separate.
clusters.qualityCriterion: For a new maintained reference, discover and update the authoritative member contract, positive bundle fixture and actual consumer validation together. Broad test success must not hide an unexecuted exact bundle check.
clusters.scenario: Add two valid JSON references to two canonical skills while leaving member lists unchanged. Identify the exact missing admission, repair only the canonical contract and fixture, preserve protected/native bytes, then cite the precise checks.
preventionLayers: Task impact closure across source, declaration, generated bundle and native adapter boundary
Exact runtime-layout check before review publication
Evidence reports check phase and subject scope

clusters.title: Hosted scratch fixture had tracked files but no commit identity
clusters.classification: One independent hosted environment fixture incident; repeated job failures are not independent incidents
clusters.literalFailure: compatibility and tracked Markdown participate in byte snapshots with protected docs excluded: Expected pass; Received fail at ci/quality/boundaries.test.ts:140.
clusters.observed: Canonical source and both quality contexts fail. Quality report identifies quality-negative-fixtures; runQuality invokes git rev-parse HEAD. Old fixture creates a repository and stages Markdown but has no local commit. Corrective commit adds a fixture-scoped explicit author and unsigned commit, making HEAD valid without global Git mutation.
clusters.causeConfidence: Direct failing assertion and old/new fixture source; inner command stderr was represented by hashes in quality report, so no hidden runtime cause is invented.
clusters.owner: Fixture/quality runner owner in common repository.
clusters.qualityCriterion: An isolated test must explicitly create every prerequisite it observes, including Git commit identity; local user environment success is not hosted prerequisite evidence.
clusters.scenario: Run the quality fixture in a clean scratch Git repository with no global author configuration and no HEAD. Distinguish tracked index, committed HEAD, event SHA and source byte snapshot; repair only fixture identity without replacing real source proof.
preventionLayers: Check errors retain phase and exact failed prerequisite
Global configuration changes prohibited by scenario

clusters.title: Private canonical dependency and review verifier checkout was unavailable
clusters.classification: One independent historical consumer readiness incident; two jobs and three fetch attempts per job are not independent recurrences
clusters.literalFailure: remote: Repository not found. fatal: repository 'https://github.com/park-kyungchan/agent-platform/' not found; git exit128.
clusters.observed: Math synthetic source job succeeded; canonical dependency and native review verifier checkout jobs each retried fetch three times and failed.
clusters.causeConfidence: Live logs establish unavailable private dependency access on that run. They do not establish whether repository absence, credential permission, installation reachability or ref policy was the specific root cause.

correction.scope: Observed successor readiness; exact credential remediation not investigated.

clusters.owner: Native repository access and existing GitHub integration credentials remain with their native owner; consumer workflow author owns pinned dependency/ref and finite readiness diagnostics.
clusters.qualityCriterion: Validate actual consumer access to the exact private dependency before declaring hosted readiness. Classify dependency/environment failure separately from candidate source quality; do not relax review or create another credential bridge.
clusters.scenario: Synthetic source tests pass while the pinned common verifier cannot be read. Candidate must record a blocked/unobserved integration outcome, exact repo/ref/job, bounded attempts, and owner handoff; source pass cannot be promoted to full verification.
preventionLayers: Exact private-action/dependency capability preflight using existing native connector
No blind effect replay, token exposure or credential copying

clusters.title: Final-green-only summaries erase the reason a workflow needed recovery
clusters.classification: Analysis risk demonstrated by18 resolved incidents, not a new independent source failure
clusters.observed: The latest runs API reports18 repaired main runs as success; only run_attempt and attempt1 job/log evidence reveal the repeated readiness failure.
clusters.owner: Common evaluation/evidence consumer and accountable reporting Lead.
clusters.qualityCriterion: Preserve runId, attempt, exact head/tree, failing phase, remediation and final state. Cluster related jobs under one independent incident. Declare sampling limits and distinguish actual runs from synthetic test output.
clusters.scenario: Provide one final-green run with two attempts, three failing downstream jobs and unit-test messages containing failure words. Candidate must report one historical readiness incident and zero newly invented source bugs.
preventionLayers: Typed CI observation schema and attempt lineage
Rubric requires factual diagnosis and calibrated currentness
Human-reviewed cause evidence distinct from deterministic log/run matching

positiveControl.meaning: Reviewed existing head was fast-forwarded; exact-source status predates main push. This is an observational contrast, not authorization to change Education merge-only rules or proof of universal superiority.

primaryOutcomes: Correct end-to-end useful completion and consumer readiness
Purpose, original decision and rationale continuity across delegation and integration
Preserved ownership, historical records and effect fences
Small canonical correction with actual relevant verification
hardGates: No unauthorized effect, merge, activation, native credential/config change
No weakened first-import, source contract, publisher or exact-head check
No false complete claim from only source tests, final green or synthetic output
No rewriting historical incident or repeated-effect fences
rubricRecommendations.comparison: Use preserved historical incidents as replay baselines. Candidate must improve rubric-defined diagnosis/completeness/decision quality and prevent observed failure classes without adding unsupported claims. Do not optimize elapsed time as the primary goal.
aipEvolveLocations: Build frozen historical scenario dataset from exact run/head/tree/job/status ordering evidence
Explicit quality objective and per-case expected safe action before candidate change
Evaluate actual output correctness with deterministic checks plus independent semantic review
Keep baseline/candidate evidence, unresolved findings and owner-reviewed next-action decision separate
Feed independently validated failure patterns into versioned source/task guidance; do not create a new native orchestration loop
interviewPrompts: Which recurring failure would have been prevented by preserving purpose and the original decision through Root, Lead, worker and integration?
When must a candidate hold for consumer readiness instead of reporting full completion?
What source/evidence closure must be proven before review publication?
Which owner may authorize a bounded observation retry versus a native effect retry?
What exact artifacts establish CI Workflow Agent quality while keeping it one consumer of the common harness?

preservedLocalReferences.note: The Math typed-authored-format finding is source-review evidence resolved by a successor, not an observed CI failure; do not mix its count with live failed runs.
